title: Rosalind and the Crown
author: Zephyrine Ashgrove
blurb: Oscar Joubert, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when the old gods begin answering prayers again, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
